titleEn: A Quiet Voice When Sonu Sleeps!

pages.text: "Tweet, tweet, tweet!" Mina sang the new bird song loudly inside. High water had narrowed the yard, so everyone stayed in the room. Beside Mina, round-bellied little Sonu slept under a quilt.
"Wake up! I learned a song!" Mina wanted Sonu to hear it right away. Sonu kept eyes closed, breathing softly. Mina sang even louder beside an ear. "Tweet!"
Startled, Sonu's eyes flew open. "Waaah!" Crying filled the room, drowning out the bird song.
Mom held Sonu and patted their back. Sonu's shoulders shook after crying. Mina stood by the door, mouth shut.
Mom showed one finger at her lips. "Shh." Mina tried it, too. "Shh." Sonu's cries slowly faded.
Mina sang very quietly beside Sonu. "Tweet, tweet..." As soft as breathing. "A Quiet Voice When Sonu Sleeps!"
Sonu's eyes slowly closed, and soft breathing returned. Mina kept the song inside their mouth. In the quiet room, even the river beyond the yard could be heard.
Mom sat beside Mina. "If you'd like to sing loudly, sing in the yard after Sonu wakes." Mina nodded.
After the nap, they stood together in the yard. "Now I'll sing my new song!" Tweet, tweet, tweet. Sonu sang along.
Mom touched her cheek to Mina's. Sonu looked up from below. "Sing it again!"
